asked.item: automatically post to the Facebook Group
missing setting or Facebook approval for the Group

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that Blotato cannot publish to Facebook Groups, which answers the customer's question about posting to the Group.

steps.text: Blotato cannot post to Facebook Groups; it publishes to Facebook Pages only.
Facebook does not let third-party tools like Blotato post to Facebook Groups.
Blotato publishes to Facebook Pages, so your connected Page is where posts can go.
